children: The number of foreign tourist arrivals in Sri Lanka fell by 3.3% year-on-year to 191,704 in August 2026, following a 1.7% decrease in the previous month.

This marked the fifth year-on-year monthly decline so far this year, although the cumulative tourist arrivals for the first eight months of 2026 successfully crossed the 1.5 million milestone, reaching 1,535,122.
India continued to dominate as the top source market, accounting for 25.0% of arrivals with 47,253 visitors, followed by the UK with 19,588 (10.0%).
China rose to third with 12,321 arrivals (6.0%), overtaking Germany, which slipped to fourth with 11,405 (6.0%).
France rounded out the top five with 10,885 visitors (6.0%).
Meanwhile, Sri Lanka cut its 2026 tourist arrival target to 2.7 million from 3 million and lowered its tourism revenue goal to $4.2 billion from $5 billion amid weakening visitor numbers.
The country also lost hosting rights for the February 2027 Women’s Champions Trophy, which was expected to boost tourism.

title: Sri Lanka Tourist Arrivals Fall Again in August
